headlines.title: CMA CGM finalizes $1.4B acquisition of FedEx Supply Chain
headlines.summary: FedEx has unloaded its Supply Chain subsidiary to CMA CGM Group for $1.4 billion to concentrate on its freight transportation and parcel delivery services. The post CMA CGM finalizes $1.4B acquisition of FedEx Supply Chain appeared first on FreightWaves.

headlines.title: Harbinger lands $300M-plus FedEx order for 2,000 EV trucks
headlines.summary: Harbinger calls it one of the largest binding orders ever placed for medium- or heavy-duty electric trucks. All 2,000 units are slated for delivery by the end of 2027. The post Harbinger lands $300M-plus FedEx order for 2,000 EV trucks appeared first on FreightWaves.

headlines.title: Harbinger Receives Order for 2,000 Electric Trucks from FedEx valued at over $300 Million
headlines.summary: Harbinger, an American automotive and industrial manufacturer, today announced it has received an order for 2,000 of its all-electric trucks from FedEx, with a total order value which exceeds $300 million. This transaction, believed to be one of the largest binding orders for electric medium or heavy-duty trucks in history, marks an expansion of FedEx's use of Harbinger vehicles and is a step in its fleet electrification strategy.

headlines.title: FedEx orders 2,000 electric trucks from Harbinger in $300M deal
headlines.summary: The order -- Harbinger's biggest ever -- comes as the startup is reportedly considering an IPO.

headlines.title: The $3T AI spend, grid bottlenecks, and the indexing trap
headlines.summary: Kelly Intelligence's Kevin Kelly and Visible Alpha's Melissa Otto map out the next phase of the AI supercycle and break the massive energy grid bottleneck threatening the AI boom.

description: FedEx Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides transportation, e-commerce, and business services in the United States and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Express U.S. Domestic and Express International. It provides e-commerce and digital solutions; dataworks; printing and shipping management, including digital printing, professional finishing, document creation, design solutions, direct mail, signs and graphics, custom-branded boxes, copying, computer rental, Wi-Fi, corporate print solutions, shredding, U.S. passport processing and renewal, and digital notarization; packing services, as well as packing supplies and boxes; document and business services; and retail access for package transportation. In addition, the company offers logistics services, air and ocean cargo transportation, specialty transportation, customs brokerage, trade management tools and data, and door-to-door solutions; and third party logistics and supply chain management solutions, such as inbound logistics, warehousing and distribution, fulfillment, contract packaging and product configuration, systems integration, returns process and disposition, test, repair, refurbishment, and product liquidation. Further, it provides sales, marketing, administrative, information technology, and back-office support services. FedEx Corporation was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee.
